# Idempotence expectation not enforced by uniqueness constraint

Comments assert an idempotence check for compile runs per (repo, pr) but the code adds a non-unique index rather than a uniqueness constraint. If idempotence relies only on the index and not on application logic or a uniqueness constraint, duplicate succeeded runs could still be created.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/storage/schema.py` — `knowledge_compiler.storage.schema.CompileRun`
